rule: STRICT VISUAL RULE: every human, creature, animal, skull, statue, carving and decoration must have NO visible facial features: no eyes, eye sockets, glowing eyes, nose, nostrils, mouth, teeth, lips or facial anatomy. Completely cover each head/front of face with opaque heavy cloth or a smooth featureless closed helmet; deep hoods contain uniform black empty void, not a dim face. No face-shaped mask, no eye slits. Remove skull ornaments and replace with plain stones/metal. Keep elegant dark fantasy painted game art, crisp readable silhouette and material texture.
